units.function: Focused portability ZIP-codec tests distinguishing root-level blob-store objects from text files and preserving arbitrary/invalid-UTF-8 bytes as base64 octet-stream entries.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite imports the production CLI ZIP reader/converter and the already-audited deterministic stored-ZIP fixture builder. It exercises in-memory archives only, without filesystem extraction or full portability schema import.
units.keyDataModels: Archive root path, normalized file map, UTF-8 text entries and base64 portable file entries with application/octet-stream content type; blob-store paths are exactly blobs/<single-segment> optionally under one package root.
units.lifecycle: Classify archive path; decode valid UTF-8 to text; preserve known blob paths or invalid UTF-8 as base64; read a package-root ZIP and round-trip mixed text/blob/raw bytes into a portable file map.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 5/5 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. It provides strong byte-fidelity evidence for small stored archives, Unicode text and invalid UTF-8. It omits compressed entries, traversal/absolute/collision paths, duplicate entries, symlinks, CRC corruption, encrypted/ZIP64 archives, size/ratio/depth/count limits, MIME verification and malformed central directories.
units.designRationale: Avoid corrupting binary evidence or extensionless files during Company portability by using strict UTF-8 decoding and an explicit binary representation independent of filename extension.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS migration, FDE templates and evidence export/import require byte-exact, content-addressed artifacts with safe archive admission and stable provenance across cloud/local profiles.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT strict text-versus-binary conversion and byte-exact round-trip tests. Use one canonical maintained archive codec, a signed manifest with per-entry digest/size/type/purpose, streaming limits and collision-free normalized paths; evidence blobs should remain content-addressed and never rely only on their directory name for trust.
units.responsibilityConflict: Byte fidelity preserves evidence content but does not establish who produced it, which Work/Run/permission/data contract it belongs to or whether its provenance and authorization survived export/import.
evidence: 916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f Replace host-to-host Cloud Sync with full-fidelity company Import/Export (#10507)
2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 5 tests passed
securityFindings: No archive entry count, compressed/uncompressed size, ratio, total memory, filename length or nesting limit is tested, leaving ZIP-bomb/denial-of-service admission unproved.
Traversal, absolute paths, backslashes, Unicode normalization, case collisions, duplicate normalized names and reserved filenames are not tested.
CRC/digest mismatch, malformed headers/central directory, ZIP64, encryption, data descriptors and unsupported compression behavior are not covered.
Binary content type is always application/octet-stream in this converter; claimed/actual media type, malware scanning and safe serving policy need separate validation.
Recognizing blobs/<id> by path shape does not validate an opaque content hash or manifest membership.
The archive is fully in memory in this test; large production imports require bounded streaming and transactional staging.
